the fixture is a minimal hand-made MIT-compatible test file. it reproduces structures observed in these public projects without redistributing their files:

- https://github.com/Hugoyhu/SL2.1A-Type-C-Hub (repository license: see upstream repository; inspected file was used only as a source of test structures)
- https://github.com/m5stack/M5_Hardware (repository license: see upstream repository; inspected file was used only as a source of test structures)

full source files were downloaded to `/tmp/coalesce-pcb-hub` and `/tmp/coalesce-pcb-m5` for local validation and are not committed. the hand-made fixture avoids copying project assets or license-restricted content.
